source: User-supplied 3D GAME CHARACTER - MODEL APPROVAL SHEET (v5), front, side, back, and 3/4 reference
method: Standalone DCC-authored, hand-shaped and skinned GLB garment asset, not runtime primitive cylinders or generated clothing tubes.

shirt.color: dark navy blue with subtle cotton knit texture
shirt.shape: loose but anatomically tapered, not straight or barrel shaped
shirt.collar: standing folded navy collar at chin level, with open unobstructed face
shirt.sleeves: continuous garment sleeves with naturally folded cuffs reaching above elbows
shirt.drape: slight asymmetric folds under chest, gathered lower hem, no hard planar shelf
shirt.skin: no exposed shoulder holes, neck clipping, or skin breakthrough
shirt.back: Uchiha red upper half, white lower fan with white handle, centered across shoulder blades, full round fan not half a semicircle

shorts.cut: two true separate above-knee Bermuda legs, slightly loose, natural gusset and fabric folds
shorts.detail: visible waist, pockets, sewn side seam, slightly hemmed cuffs
shorts.accessories: two navy bands and small slender pouch on character right short leg
shorts.restrictions: no rigid cylinders, dark triangles, rectangular flap boxes, disconnected waist, or skin clipping

animation.idle: cloth has subtle but not distracting motion
animation.attacks: no shoulder seam separation, sleeves and shorts deform smoothly with limbs
animation.run: no waist detachment, knees remain clear, legs separate, cloth follows thigh skinning

mandatory_manual_checks: source reference side-by-side crop, same camera height and body scale
shirt silhouette and sleeve profile match from front and side
collar upper opening exposes mouth and never crosses cheek/eyes
shorts hem width, length and folds match from front and back
fan back crest is centered, proportional, full and unobscured
skin-wrap, waist and seam overlaps absent in all combat poses
no disconnected mesh or floating surfaces on model
hand and leg mesh separation preserved
verification.merge_gate: Only sign if all checks pass; automated rig tests are necessary but insufficient

defects: straight box-shaped shirt, unnatural rigid shoulder silhouette
shorts too broad/square with minimal cloth-like geometry
crest is visually incorrect/too small on back
missing natural seam, fold and pocket detail
overall render far below approval sheet reference

inspection_priority: Collar should be folded and tapered, sitting just below the mouth, leaving the face visible
Rounded shoulder seam flows into short relaxed sleeves, no poncho-like flat shoulders
Fabric drapes smoothly across chest, gathering into three or more asymmetric visible folds above shirt hem
Slightly relaxed hem covers gray shorts waistband without holes, hard cutoff or gray protrusions
Back fan should have full rounded red cap and broad white lower section plus centered straight handle
Back logo located centered just below shoulder blades, correctly scaled and not stretched or flattened
Cotton knit material remains dark navy, no metallic blue or bright generic sportswear look
